summary: NatWest Group plc filed a Form 6-K disclosing routine PDMR share sales under UK Market Abuse Regulation Article 19. Executives including the CEO, CFO, and Retail CEO sold ordinary shares under previously announced irrevocable trading plans on 2 September 2026 at £6.9023 per share. This is a standard disclosure of insider share transactions, not a special-situation event. No strategic action, tender, or corporate event is involved. The filing is informational only, with no deal terms, recommendation, or structural considerations to analyze.
